items.description: Fix bug-home-record-tasting-opens-wrong-batch: in app/src/ui/RecipeList.jsx the AWAITING_TASTING action builds tastingPath from entry.latestVersion.id and entry.batches[0].id without checking the batch belongs to that version, so Home's Record a tasting on Mexican Chocolate lands on /notebook/mexican-chocolate/mexican-chocolate-v4/batch/mexican-chocolate-v3-batch-01 with no pen open; pair the batch with its own version (the version the batch was recorded against), and add a test that reproduces the v4/v3 case.

Boot line word for the problems table (decide-p9-boot-word-problems = tasting-problems): in app/src/store/seedTables.js SEED_TABLES.problems.word becomes 'tasting problems' so the boot line reads "Sprinkles can’t open: its list of tasting problems has a damaged entry."; update the tests that pin the word; the line stays one sentence.

Facts line value-first (decide-p9-facts-line-shape = value-first): in app/src/ui/IngredientsPlace.jsx factsText drops the labels where the value speaks and shows the hydration temperature as a number: "Density 0.994 g/ml · Ultra-pasteurised · Granulated, loose · Hydrates at 80–85 °C" (heat treatment and packed state values capitalised as the first word of their fact; the hydration source's prose no longer replaces the figure, which is shown as a number with the unit; keep the middle-dot join and order; update IngredientsPlace tests and 09-places-check expectations only if they pin the old words).
